blocks.text: SCHEDULE: Gilas Pilipinas at Fiba Asian Qualifiers Window 5 MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas rolled past Syria, 97-58, to gain a share of third place with Iran and Jordan in Group E of the Fiba World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers on Friday at Karisma Arena in Seremban, Malaysia. Bennie Boatwright was good as advertised in his debut as a naturalized player after delivering 16 points and 13 rebounds in a performance that was only part of how Gilas dominated the Syrian side to begin the fifth window.
